overview: This 254-page file combines Bank of Japan financial statistics with U.S. occupation records on liquidating wartime institutions, restoring remittances, expanding foreign banking, and debating Japanese banking reform. Later correspondence addresses American investment, securities registration, and import and export taxes.
interest: Successive policy drafts reveal how U.S. officials negotiated Japanese banking autonomy while reopening international finance after the war.
